# Airports — Baja California Sur

Ontology: `rc_aeropuerto_sjd` · `rc_aeropuerto_lap` · demand `dd_turismo_cabos` · `dd_turismo_lapaz`.

Scope: SJD (Los Cabos / San José del Cabo), LAP (La Paz), LTO (Loreto). No other commercial international airports named in SETUE IE 2026 as the “tres aeropuertos internacionales.”

**Rules applied:** figures only from on-disk official/state sources; airline names not invented; LTO Proyectos México ficha **MISSING**.

---

## 1. Inventory and physical assets

| Code | Name | Operator / concession | Runway | Terminal | Contract | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SJD** | Aeropuerto Internacional de Los Cabos (San José del Cabo) | Concesión operate/exploit (Proyectos México 0302); GAP cited in SETUE fuentes | 1 pista **3,004 m × 45 m** | **15,130 m²** | 01/11/1998 – 31/10/2048 (50 años) | Proyectos México Ficha 0302 (act. 01/04/2020) |
| **LAP** | Aeropuerto Internacional de La Paz “Manuel Márquez de León” | Same concession model (0305) | 1 pista **2,500 m × 45 m** | **5,900 m²** | 01/11/1998 – 31/10/2048 | Proyectos México Ficha 0305 (act. 30/06/2020). **Body paste error** says “Hermosillo” — ignore; title/geo are BCS. |
| **LTO** | Aeropuerto Internacional de Loreto | GAP cited as source for Loreto traffic in SETUE IE BCS 2026 “Fuentes” | **UNKNOWN** (no PM ficha on disk) | **UNKNOWN** | **MISSING** ficha 0303 (`00_catalog/MISSING_investment.md`) | SETUE IE BCS 2026 fuentes list |

SICT Programa Sectorial 2025–2030 (DOF 05/09/2025) names **ampliación y remodelación del edificio terminal de San José del Cabo** and **construcción de nueva estación de combustibles en San José del Cabo** as national programme items — not passenger stats.

---

## 2. Passenger volumes (sourced)

### Calendar / SETUE IE 2026 (OCR of styled text; see `_downloads/ocr_notes/`)

| Airport / grain | Passengers 2025 | YoY | Share / note | Source |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| **BCS three airports** | **4 millones 523 mil** (≈ 4.523 M; unit digits not recovered beyond “mil”) | **+2.0%** vs 2024 | — | SETUE IE BCS 2026 p.20 (OCR) |
| **SJD (Los Cabos)** | **3.8 millones** | **+0.6%** | **83.2%** of state air arrivals | SETUE IE Los Cabos 2026 p.14 (OCR) · `rc_aeropuerto_sjd` · `dd_turismo_cabos` |
| **LAP (La Paz)** | **668,800** | **+10.9%** | — | SETUE IE La Paz 2026 p.14 (OCR) · `rc_aeropuerto_lap` |
| **LTO (Loreto)** | **UNKNOWN** for CY 2025 in SETUE Loreto IE (file not on disk) | — | Residual ≈ state − SJD − LAP if those are exhaustive; not published as a 2025 line here | Gap |

Cross-check arithmetic (informative only): 3.8 M / 0.832 ≈ 4.57 M state — slight tension with “4.523 M” likely from rounding of “3.8 millones.” Prefer stating each figure as published rather than reconciling.

### Official state annex (Sept–Aug years; older)

From Gobierno BCS 2º Informe, Anexo gráfico y estadístico (2023), table “Llegada de pasajeros vía aérea por municipio”:

| Municipio | 2021–2022 (miles) | 2022–2023 (miles) |
|---|---:|---:|
| La Paz | 536.8 (nac. 524.9 / int. 11.7) | 546.9 (538.3 / 8.6) |
| Los Cabos | 3,384.3 (1,203.9 / 2,180.5) | 3,836.8 (1,466.9 / 2,370.1) |
| Loreto | 63.9 (25.8 / 38.1) | 78.1 (30.9 / 47.2) |
| **Total BCS** | **3,985.0** | **4,461.8** |

Fuente en tabla: SETUE Subsecretaría de Turismo. Periodo 1 sep – 31 ago. Commercial + charter.

Same annex: “operaciones” (not pax) 2021–22 / 2022–23 prelim. to 31 Jul: La Paz 5,300 / 4,496; Los Cabos 23,852 / 23,813; Loreto 808 / 812; total 29,960 / 29,121 (DATATUR).

---

## 3. Routes / airlines

| Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| SJD: **7** European / **39** North America / **16** Mexico connections; **+500** weekly flights | Counts only — **airline names UNKNOWN** in pack | PMD Los Cabos 2024–2027 citing FITURCA 2024 |
| Named carriers / city-pair schedule | **UNKNOWN** | Not in Proyectos México fichas, SETUE IE, or SICT extract |
| GAP monthly traffic Excel/PDF 2025 | **NOT DOWNLOADED** this pass (probe page empty of figures) | Gap |

See `airports_connections.csv` for structured rows.

---

## 4. Role in territorial demand

- **SJD** is the primary international door for `dd_turismo_cabos` (83.2% of state air; majority international hotel demand in Los Cabos).
- **LAP** is the capital / domestic-leaning door (`dd_turismo_lapaz`); 2025 air pax grew faster YoY than SJD in SETUE IE.
- **LTO** is a small third door historically (≈78k pax Sept22–Aug23); 2025 calendar figure **UNKNOWN** without SETUE Loreto IE.

## 3. SETUE IE 2026 corroboration (state / Los Cabos / La Paz)

| Claim | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BCS cruise passengers 2025 | **1,311,036** (+46.2% vs prior year) | SETUE IE BCS 2026 (pdftotext + OCR context) |

| La Paz “turismo náutico” passengers 2025 | **130,614** (+210.8%) | SETUE IE La Paz 2026 (OCR) — **not labelled mega-crucero only**; aligns order-of-magnitude with DataTur Pichilingue 2025 (133,269) |

PMD Los Cabos (citing SECTUR 2024): cruise excursionists **540,773 (2022) → 735,686 (2023)**; “4to puerto” nationally by cruise. Older than DataTur 2025.

Gobierno BCS 2º Informe annex (“Pasajeros de mega cruceros”, Sept–Aug): Los Cabos 295,383 (2021–22) → 845,345 (2022–23); La Paz 12,319 → 34,857; Loreto 11,514 → 26,911; total 319,216 → 907,113.

---

## 4. Territorial reading (evidence only)

- **Cabo San Lucas** = cruise primate for BCS and a top Pacific port in DataTur 2025–26 YTD.
- **Pichilingue** (La Paz municipality API area) = second BCS call/pax node; surge 2024→2025 passengers.
- **Loreto / San Carlos / Santa Rosalía / Puerto Escondido BCS** = secondary / volatile; small absolute pax vs CSL.
- Cruise load is day-visitor / excursionist pressure on `dd_turismo_cabos`, distinct from hotel overnight demand and from yacht marina occupancy.

markdown.yachts_profile.md:
# Yacht tourism profile — Baja California Sur

**Hard rule:** cruise ≠ yacht. LOA class bands, mega-yacht counts, and berth mix by length are **UNKNOWN** unless a sourced document states them. This note only repeats marina **slip counts** and narrative claims that appear in SETUE / PMD / Observatorio citations.

Ontology: supports `dd_turismo_cabos` / `dd_turismo_lapaz` as a secondary nautical channel; does not replace hotel or cruise series.

---

## 1. What can be said rigorously

| Indicator | Value | Geography | Source | Caveat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marina tourist slips | **759** | Municipio Los Cabos | SETUE IE Los Cabos 2026 (OCR); also PMD Los Cabos 2024–2027 | “espacios disponibles” — not LOA-classed |
| Share of BCS marina spaces | **45%** | Los Cabos / BCS | SETUE IE Los Cabos 2026 (OCR) | Implies BCS total ≈ **1,687** if 759 = 45% (derived; SETUE BCS page number incomplete in OCR) |
| Marina tourist slips | **751** | Municipio La Paz | SETUE IE La Paz 2026 (OCR) | “municipio con más espacios disponibles” |
| Golf (context, not yacht) | 18 courses Los Cabos; 2 La Paz | — | SETUE IE | Not marina capacity |
| Blue Flag / marina certifications | Blue Flag count in SETUE annex certifications table (state): 25 in both 2021–22 and 2022–23 | BCS | 2º Informe annex | Not slip inventory |

Derived residual slips outside Los Cabos + La Paz: 1,687 − 759 − 751 ≈ **177** — **UNKNOWN** by municipality (Loreto / others not broken out in SETUE IE on disk).

---

## 2. What is NOT evidenced (mark UNKNOWN)

| Topic | Status |
|---|---|
| LOA classes (e.g. <40 ft / 40–80 / 80–120 / >120) | **UNKNOWN** |
| Mega-yacht berths or annual mega-yacht calls | **UNKNOWN** as a distinct series (PMD conflates “cruceros y yates” in one Observatorio sentence — see below) |
| Occupancy rate of marina slips | **UNKNOWN** |
| Transient vs annual contracts | **UNKNOWN** |
| Named marinas capacity table (Cabo Marina, Puerto Los Cabos, Marina Palmira, etc.) | **UNKNOWN** in this pack |
| Average LOA or beam limits | **UNKNOWN** |

---

## 3. Mixed cruise+yacht citations (do not use as yacht-only)

PMD Los Cabos 2024–2027 (citing SETUE IE Los Cabos 2023 / Observatorio Turístico Los Cabos 2023):

> arribaron más de **560 mil** visitantes a través de **cruceros y yates** en **178 embarcaciones** … total anual de **4,060,000** visitantes (with air).

This **combines** cruise and yacht. It cannot support a yacht-only passenger or vessel count. Prefer DataTur/SEMAR for cruise and SETUE marina **slip** counts for yacht infrastructure.

SETUE IE BCS 2026 states nautical tourism is consolidating and that marina spaces exist for yacht travellers; the absolute state slip total was not recovered cleanly by OCR beyond the Los Cabos 45% share.

---

## 4. Territorial implication (evidence-bound)

- Yacht infrastructure is **material** (order of **~1.7k** tourist marina spaces statewide; Cabos ≈ La Paz in slip count).
- Without LOA typology, carrying-capacity work cannot allocate waterfront berths by mega-yacht vs recreational — treat as **UNKNOWN typology**, known **slip stock**.
- Do not use cruise pax/call tables as yacht demand.
markdown.demand_target_groups.md:
# Demand target groups — BCS (evidence personas)

Ontology: `dd_turismo_cabos` · `dd_residencial_cabos` · `rc_aeropuerto_sjd` · `rc_aeropuerto_lap`.

No marketing fluff. Each persona = who they are + quantitative evidence + gaps.

---

## A. Tourists — overnight hotel / motel

### A1. International overnight visitor — Los Cabos (`dd_turismo_cabos`)

| Evidence | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Hotel/motel arrivals Los Cabos 2025 | **≈ 3.1 millones** turistas | SETUE IE Los Cabos 2026 (OCR); chart total 3,091.5 miles |
| Share no residente (extranjero) | **71.2%** of hotel arrivals 2025 | SETUE IE Los Cabos 2026 |
| Chart 2025 (miles): Total / No res. / Res. | 3,091.5 / 2,201.9 / 889.6 | SETUE IE Los Cabos chart |
| Occupancy 2025 | **70.0%**; estadía **4.7 días** | SETUE IE Los Cabos 2026 |
| Occupancy 2024 (SECTUR csv derived) | **73.2%**; arrivals 3,047,996 (NR 2,208,094 + R 839,902) | `2016-2024_SECTUR_Ocupacion_hotelera_*.csv` |
| Rooms | 188 hotels / **22,254** rooms (SETUE 2026); ≈ 3 of 4 BCS rooms | SETUE IE Los Cabos |
| Air door | SJD **3.8 M** pax 2025; 83.2% of BCS air | SETUE · `rc_aeropuerto_sjd` |
| Market emitters named | Doméstico / **EE.UU.** / **Canadá** (PMD pie) | PMD Los Cabos p.53 |
| Exact US / Canada / MX % on PMD pie | Text extract shows labels **43% / 50% / 7%** adjacent to Doméstico–EE.UU.–Canadá; **layout ambiguous vs 71.2% NR** — treat three-way split as **UNCERTAIN**; prefer SETUE NR/R | Gap |

**Persona (evidence):** long-stay, high-ADR international leisure guest concentrated on CSL–SJC corridor; enters via SJD; competes for water/energy with residents (`dd_residencial_cabos`).

### A2. Domestic overnight visitor — La Paz / Loreto

| Evidence | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| La Paz hotel arrivals 2025 | **575,509**; **79.4%** nacional (residentes) | SETUE IE La Paz 2026 |
| La Paz occupancy / stay | **64%**; **2.04 días** | SETUE IE La Paz |
| La Paz air | **668,800** pax 2025 (+10.9%) | SETUE · `rc_aeropuerto_lap` |
| Loreto hotel 2024 (csv) | Occ. **45.7%**; arrivals 115,014 (NR 71,366 + R 43,648) | SECTUR occupancy csv |
| SETUE narrative | La Paz & Loreto = preferred for national vacationers; Cabos = foreign concentration | SETUE IE BCS 2026 |

**Persona:** shorter-stay national visitor; secondary international share; lower ADR/occupancy than Cabos.

### A3. BCS-level hotel aggregate

| Evidence | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Hotel visitors 2025 (est.) | **3.8 millones**; extranjeros **53.0%** | SETUE IE BCS 2026 OCR |
| Stock | **508** establishments; **29,245** rooms | SETUE IE BCS |
| Occupancy / stay 2025 | **68.0%**; **4 días** | SETUE IE BCS OCR |
| Derrama | **28,968 millones MXN** (última cifra disponible) | SETUE IE BCS OCR |

---

## B. Cruise excursionists (day visitors)

Distinct from A (overnight). See `cruises.md`.

| Evidence | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BCS cruise pax 2025 | **1,311,036** (+46.2%) | SETUE IE BCS |
| CSL calls / pax 2025 | **322** / **≈1.1 M**; 9/10 of state cruise visitors | SETUE IE Los Cabos |
| DataTur CSL pax 2025 | **1,057,758** | SECTUR DataTur May-2026 PDF |
| DataTur CSL Ene–May 2026 | **697,234** pax (+69.8% vs Ene–May 2025) | same |

**Persona:** large-ship day visitor, overwhelmingly CSL; low hotel night capture; high peak load on waterfront / tours.

---

## C. Yacht / marina users

See `yachts_profile.md`. Slip stock known (~759 Cabos, ~751 La Paz); **visitor counts and LOA typology UNKNOWN**. PMD “cruceros y yates” mix is **not** a yacht persona denominator.

---

## D. Expats / second homes (`dd_residencial_cabos`)

### What census PNACOE actually measures

INEGI Censo 2020 field **PNACOE** = población **nacida en otra entidad federativa** (other Mexican state) — **not** foreign-born expats.

| Geography | POBTOT | PNACENT (born in BCS) | PNACOE (born other MX state) | PNACOE share | Source |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| BCS | 798,447 | 470,255 | 313,283 | 39.2% | Censo 2020 municipal extract |
| **Los Cabos** | **351,111** | **151,671** | **191,408** | **54.5%** | same · T1_02 |
| La Paz | 292,241 | 207,402 | 79,830 | 27.3% | same |
| Loreto | 18,052 | 13,594 | 4,147 | 23.0% | same |

**PRESOE15** (resided in another entity in 2015): Los Cabos **49,554** — recent internal in-migration signal.

**Foreign-born / US-Canada resident counts:** **UNKNOWN** in this pack (no PNACEX-style municipal extract; Panorama sociodemográfico definitions mention extranjeros in total population concept but no municipal foreign-born table harvested here).

**Second-home / short-stay platforms:** PMD cites **7,570** short-stay platform spaces (T2 2023) in Los Cabos — proxy for visitor/second-home stock, not census expats.

**Persona (evidence-bound):** Los Cabos is an **internal-migration tourism labour + residential pole** (majority born outside BCS). True “expat” (foreign national) headcount remains a **GAP**. Use `dd_residencial_cabos` for water/energy competition without inventing foreign counts.

---

## E. Locals — poverty, occupation, labour

### E1. Poverty (CONEVAL municipal 2020)

| Municipio | % pobreza 2020 | Personas 2020 | % pobreza extrema 2020 | Source |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| La Paz | **20.61** | 67,252 | 1.89 | `2020-12-31_CONEVAL_Pobreza_municipal_BCS_2010-2020.csv` |
| Mulegé | 24.11 | 16,854 | 3.16 | same |
| **Los Cabos** | **31.70** | **124,138** | **4.77** | same |
| Loreto | 34.08 | 6,572 | 2.94 | same |
| Comondú | 34.95 | 27,374 | 4.28 | same |

Note: CONEVAL population base ≠ Censo POBTOT (e.g. Los Cabos 2020* 391,603 vs census 351,111). Do not mix bases.

Los Cabos: poverty **rose** 2015→2020 while census population exploded — tourism pole ≠ social-success pole (T1_02).

### E2. Occupation / labour

| Indicator | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Censo 2020 PEA / ocupada Los Cabos | 194,484 / 191,248 | Censo municipal |
| Censo 2020 PEA / ocupada La Paz | 154,830 / 152,265 | same |
| ENOE BCS 2026 T2 PEA | **512 mil**; ocupados **500 mil**; desocupación **2.3%**; informalidad TIL1 **39.6%**; subocupación **8.4%**; TCCO **22.8%** | `2026-08-25_INEGI_ENOE_2026T2_BCS.pdf` |

**Persona — local worker in tourism pole:** employed at high participation / low open unemployment, but elevated poverty and critical occupancy conditions in the same municipality that hosts luxury demand — evidence of dual labour/housing market, not a single “prosperous destination” narrative.

### E3. Housing stress flags (IRS 2020, from T1_02)
